highlights.finding: Four front bridge motor failures on historic v10 isolated. New corner checkpoint passed all 40 parked motor tests and 24 signed motion cases.
One complete Material-03 issue is identified separately from its experimental successor chassis and historic public images.

failures.finding: B3 relay does not establish a Blue 1 close scoring outcome. For 1780 all 10 focal direct-policy points are prescribed AUTO outcomes.
The original full camshaft intersects the finger. The split link drive clears the center but traverses both trial portal members. R18 has no scored integrated handoff.
